items.text: Surround, for headsets such as Apple Vision Pro: the stage on a curved wall all around you, and a pinch works as a touch. It appears in the tool shelf only where the browser offers it. The room does not show through: Safari on Vision Pro does not allow that to web pages, so it replaces the room. Not yet tried on a headset

Prism, on the mic tab: a bank of resonators tuned to a chord, so the room rings in it. Four presets (Struck Glass, Tuned Street, Prism Arp, Bent Bell), depth, decay, spacing, drift, chord, root and an arpeggio. It is a shared Surface module, so other instruments can load the same one
a credit that did not belong is removed
fill strength and drain speed, 25% to 400%, in the water panel and on the Material ring's Fill and Drain dots
on an iPad or phone, after ten minutes away the sound rests for real to save battery, and starts again by itself when you come back (music from a file starts from its beginning)
on an iPad or phone, coming back to Current no longer leaves it silent: Power save now lowers the sound to nothing while you are away instead of pausing the sound engine
the Words ring has a round middle, like every other ring; it is the sequence's switch, lit while the words play
